data.text: The earth is the LORD’s, and all it contains, the world and those who dwell in it.
data.titulo: The LORD, Creator and King of Glory

data.text: For he founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.
Who may ascend the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?
data.titulo: Who May Approach the Holy LORD?

data.text: One with clean hands and a pure heart, who has not invoked my life in vain or sworn deceitfully.
He will receive blessing from the LORD and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face: Jacob. Selah.
Lift up your heads, gates! Be lifted up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may enter!
Who is this King of glory? The LORD, strong and mighty, the LORD, mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, gates! Lift them up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may enter!
Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD of hosts—he is the King of glory! Selah.
